name: FrenchModelVariant411_HandleRequest
evidence: matching french_model_variant/variant411_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it selects the configuration record at data + 0xFC indexed by the request and packs five texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and calls the fading-sheet helper from the sheet start and the tube and funnel helpers from the expansion start; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md, notes/overlays/french-model-variant411-entry.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the US and Japanese header-394 images build the same source through model_variant/variant394_entry.c, which selects CLUT x 512 instead of 640, and bind the helpers and data at their own addresses. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
